column1: # Partition table for the 8 MB ESP32-S3 module this reader is built on (N8R2
# whole of flash above the app: 0x800000 - 0x210000 = 0x5F0000
# It was 0x1F0000 while the table assumed a 4 MB module
# over budget. Single app slot: there is no OTA in this firmware
# second app image the stock tables reserve is pure waste here.
# The filesystem entry is named "spiffs" because that is the name PlatformIO
# and the Arduino core look for when locating the filesystem image; the image
# Larger modules: leave the first three rows alone and extend spiffs to the end

column2: for example Size 0x5F0000 on 8 MB or 0xDF0000 on 16 MB.
